text:
B: Afternoon! Gary. You alright?
A: Hi, yeah, I'm okay, thanks. I'm Sana.
B: Sana, lovely. Where are you based?
A: Luton.
B: Luton! Fly out of there sometimes, me. Cheaper than Birmingham for some flights. I'm Aldridge, near Walsall. Senior sales, industrial fixings. Road warrior, Karen calls me. What do you do?
A: Erm, I'm a kitchen assistant. At a primary school.
B: Good for you. Bet that's hard graft, all them kids.
A: It is, kind of. But I like it. I know which kids have allergies and stuff, so the cook trusts me with that.
B: That's important, that. That's responsibility. Health and safety's my world too, did a course on it, IOSH. Got a certificate somewhere.
A: Oh, I've got my food hygiene one. Level 2.
B: There you go, you're qualified. Is it your little one I can see the dinosaur of on the sofa?
A: Yeah, Zayan's. He's five. He leaves them everywhere. I stood on one this morning, it really hurt.
B: Ha! Lego's worse. My lad used to leave Lego on the stairs. He's twenty-four now, lives in Lichfield. Still leaves his stuff everywhere when he comes round.
A: Aw. So it doesn't stop then.
B: Never, love. Do you get away much, you and the little lad?
A: Erm, not really. Day trips. Southend, sometimes. I'd love to take him somewhere hot one day. Like Turkey maybe. But it's a lot of money, you know.
B: Turkey's brilliant. We've done it twice, all-inclusive. Side, near Antalya. Proper hotel, kids' pool, slides, the lot. Kids eat free some places if you book early, so keep your eye out. The trick is January, everyone puts deals out after Christmas. I always get an upgrade, me, I just ask nicely at the desk. Costs nothing to ask, does it?
A: That's a good tip, actually. I didn't know that.
B: January, write it down. Kids' pool, that's what you want for a five-year-old.
A: He'd love that. He'd never come out.
B: What do you do yourself, when you're not at the school?
A: I do henna. For weddings and Eid. People say I should make it a business.
B: You should! Weddings, there's money in weddings. Get yourself a price list, few photos online, word of mouth does the rest. That's sales, that, it's all relationships.
A: I've got an Instagram but I'm too shy to post on it. Sorry, that's a bit silly.
B: Not silly. You just post the work, let it do the talking. You don't even have to be in it.
A: Yeah. I suppose that's true. Erm, I think we're nearly out of time.
B: Reckon so. Lovely to meet you, Sana. January, remember.
A: I will. Thank you, it was nice to meet you.
B: Tara, then.
